serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
#Landlord.Face.Grin
#Britannia.Eyes.Irritated+Britannia.Mouth.Angry
Landlord: Oh~ My Little Angel~ So you really came here after all~ Your daddy started to worry that you don’t love him no more.
Britannia: Sure- I mean, of course not…
Landlord: How about a hug? We didn’t see each other for so long! 
#Landlord.animate(MoveToLeft)
Britannia: N-No! No! I refuse!
Landlord: Come on, don’t be shy~
Britannia: Kyah! {{punch}}
#Britannia.Eyes.Closed+Britannia.Mouth.Angry
Britannia: C-Could you let me go now…
#Landlord.animate(MoveToRight)
Landlord: Sorry, I had to savor my little daughter.
#Britannia.Eyes.Irritated+Britannia.Mouth.Angry
Britannia: Ugh… {{wi}}This is a new coat, you know?
Landlord: So it seems like you decided to go with us to the island. Pack your things! Daddy has already prepared everything, and we can leave whenever you want!
Britannia: Great…
Britannia: Did you buy me a separate house there? 
She’s pushing it…
#Landlord.Face.Surprised
Landlord: Oh-uh… {{wi}}Not exactly, property there is extremely expensive, you know.
Britannia: Then I don’t know if I wanna go…
Landlord: A-Alright! I will buy another home, just for you.
#Britannia.Face.Smile
#Landlord.Face.Grin
Britannia: Thank you, Daddy~ You are so totes awesome~ 
Wow, her expression changed so quickly. I don't know what’s more impressive, her ability to be so two-faced or Landlord’s ability to be ignorant to it.
Landlord: I will buy you your own home there, but it will be next to mine, ok?
#Britannia.Face.Angry
Britannia: Tch! Fine!
#Britannia.Face.Normal
Landlord: I don’t know how to thank you, Anon! I think this is the happiest day in my life! I have no idea how you manage it, but I promise you that this is by far the greatest achievement of your life!
You: Thanks, I guess…
Britannia: Yeah, good job, palie.
She called me palie… {{wi}}That’s a new one…
Landlord: Go pack your things, Anon! We won’t be waiting for you! Remember, I have all the needed paperwork! 
You: Sure, I remember. 
#Britannia.Eyes.Normal+Britannia.Mouth.Angry
Landlord: Would you want some cup cakes, Britannie?
Britannia: Please stop.
I will leave those two to themselves. They have some catching up to do.
